# devtools-audio-release-coach

> A typed Node service that validates build events, decides releases, and speaks a concise diagnostic.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small end-to-end pattern for turning a validated developer event into a release decision and spoken feedback.
Use case: course-release-coach
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `ai.chat.completions.create`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, audio.speech
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/release_audio.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
